These tips don't take a lot of effort and give you money back from your purchases.   ShopKicks: https://app.shopkick.com/r/3-LQvl  Open the app when you walk into stores.You'll earn kicks that can be redeemed for gift cards.   Ebates: https://www.ebates.com/r/JASMIN3923?eeid=28187 Click through the links on Ebates to earn a percentage of your purchase back. Can be put towards gift cards or paid through PayPal.   TopCashBack: https://www.topcashback.com/ref/simplybyheart Click through the links at TopCashBack when making a purchase to receive a percentage of your purchase back in gift cards or cash.  Job Spotter: https://jobspotter.indeed.com/ Take pictures of help wanted signs in your area to earn points and get free Amazon gift cards.   iBotta: https://ibotta.com/r/teuuykn Create shopping list and view advertisements for items through the iBotta app. Scan your receipt as proof of purchase and earn a percent of your purchase back. About this video: This video shares five ways that I earn free gift cards every month. Free gift cards for Amazon are easy to earn through these apps. I have also earned lots of free gift cards for Starbucks. These come in handy when going through the drive through. I've also earned free Target gift cards. I use them to pick up odds and ends during the week. Check out how you can also earn free gift cards. Thank you for watching!  Intro Music: composed by Nicolai Heidlas from www.HookSounds.com
